image_location_description: Top center, between torso and head: compact LBG/white neck stack under a tan/medium-nougat head block

steps.title: Neck base plates
steps.description: Stack 2x2 plate LBG (3022) then 2x2 plate White (3022).

steps.title: Neck core column
steps.description: Add 2x White headlight bricks (4070) left/right + 2x White 1x1 bricks (3005) front/back.

steps.title: Neck side collars
steps.description: Attach 2x 1x2 tiles LBG (3069b) to the headlight side studs.

steps.title: Neck cap
steps.description: Cap with 2x2 plate LBG (3022), keep studs facing up.

steps.title: Head seat
steps.description: Add 2x2 plate Tan (3022) centered on the neck cap.

steps.title: Lower head + brow step
steps.description: Add 2x2 brick MediumNougat (3003), then 2x 1x2 plates Tan (3023) as a thin step layer.

steps.title: Upper head + cheek step
steps.description: Add 2x2 brick MediumNougat (3003), then 2x 1x2 plates Tan (3023) on top.

steps.title: Crown pre-rounding
steps.description: Place 3x 1x1 bricks MediumNougat (3005) on top to form a small dome step.

steps.title: Top cap tiles
steps.description: Add 2x2 plate Tan (3022), then 2x 1x1 tiles Tan (3070b).
